punchline: Brené Brown had always filed resentment next to anger, until she learned it belongs beside envy.
thirty_sec: Brené Brown had always thought resentment lived close to anger. After talking with emotions researcher Marc Brackett, she concluded it belongs to the envy family instead. One summary calls it bitterness over perceived unfairness, often after exhaustion. So under the grudge, the first thing to ask is what the other person has that you want.
